cards.summary: Hollow hairline-outline letters: fill opacity is 0%, leaving only a 1 px black outside Stroke, so the letters read as thin dark outlines with the grey background showing through (the stroke is stored at 1 under a 416.67% style scale, yet still renders as a hairline about 1 px wide on the 72 ppi test document, measured). Effects stored in the style: Stroke.
use_for: outline-only title over a photo or colour
avoid: dark backgrounds: the black hairline vanishes
small text: a hairline loses detail
it is not a fill: the letters are transparent inside
cards.applies_to: a text, shape or pixel layer (not the locked Background layer: double-click it to unlock first). The effects follow the layer's transparency edge, so it reads best on bold type or a solid shape. Effect sizes are in pixels: on a much larger or smaller document use Layer > Layer Style > Scale Effects. Effect sizes are stored for a 300 ppi document (style scale 416.67%): Photoshop scales them by document resolution (inferred from 72/300; measured on the Duplicates style, a stored 60 px offset showed about 13 px in the 72 ppi test document), so the thumbnail shows them at roughly 24% of the stored numbers and a 300 ppi document shows them in full. Exception measured here: the 1 px Stroke still renders as a hairline about 1 px wide (edge darkening equals roughly 0.8 px of black), not a quarter pixel. The style also sets the layer's Fill Opacity to 0% (decoded from the file): the layer's own fill is faded accordingly and the effects carry the look.
cards.how_to_apply: Styles panel menu > Import Styles... and pick <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Required/Legacy Styles and More.asl (the harvest did not find this style in the panel's default list); '1 Px Stroke 0% Fill Opacity' sits in that library (group 'Legacy Styles and More/All Legacy Default Styles/Legacy Default Styles'). Then click it with a layer selected. Script: load the file into the style presets (Action Manager set on the application's style list with the file path), then event ASty by panel position.

verified.note: Hollow letters drawn by a dark hairline about 1 px wide (darkest 10) with the grey showing through; the 1 px stored Stroke is not shrunk to a quarter pixel.

review.changes: summary and applies_to: 'renders about a quarter of that' corrected (pixel edge darkening shows about a 1 px line)
